_comment: Copy to gear_checks.json to change the gear checks shown on player cards. enchantable / socket_slots: "auto" or an explicit list of slot numbers (Blizzard inventory order, see slot_names). With "auto", a slot is required when STRICTLY MORE than `majority` (0.5 = more than half) of the roster's non-empty items in that slot carry an enchant (enchantable) or at least one gem (socket_slots); so a slot where exactly half the raid enchants (e.g. off hand: dual-wielders vs shields) is not required. An explicit list replaces the auto rule for that check. skip_slots are never checked and do not count towards the average (shirt 3, tabard 17). low_slot_gap: an item this many ilvl or more below the player's own average item level is flagged ('wrist 15 ilvl below your average').
